item.title: Ant Group Releases Ling-3.2-air Multimodal Model With 5.5B Active Parameters
item.description: Ant Group released Ling-3.2-air with text, image and video input, 124B total parameters and downloadable weights under a model-card MIT declaration.
item.author: contact@pandaily.com (Pandaily)

item.title: SenseTime Opens SenseNova U1.6 With Native Image Self-Correction
item.description: SenseTime released open SenseNova U1.6 weights and a hosted Lite update, with company-reported gains from checking and correcting image text.
item.author: contact@pandaily.com (Pandaily)

item.title: Lecoo Lists Consumer Walking-Assist Exoskeleton Ahead of China Sale
item.description: Lecoo’s walking-assistance exoskeleton is listed for a November 28 China sale at an introductory CNY 6,999; advertised specifications are not medical validation.
item.author: contact@pandaily.com (Pandaily)

item.title: Astronstone Completes Ground Validation of Full-Size Rocket Capture Arms
item.description: Astronstone says its 100-tonne-class capture arms completed joint ground validation across weather and dynamic-load conditions; no flight recovery was announced.
item.author: contact@pandaily.com (Pandaily)

item.title: XPeng Upgrades X-World 1.6 With Repeatable Virtual City Driving Tests
item.description: XPeng’s world-model upgrade recreates recorded roads for repeatable driving-AI tests, with company-reported gains in trajectory consistency and interaction latency.
item.author: contact@pandaily.com (Pandaily)
